snippet.title: Nuga-Cel:Playthrough 13
snippet.description: Now that I pretty much maxed out the stats of all the current costumes everyone has on since I spent a lot of time in the shop getting stat boosters I continue on and take on another dungeon so a variety of monsters and things will be being fought again here and eventually obtaining another new weapon. This dungeon is a big league more harder than previous ones and this one has multiple bosses in it and do not underestimate them either they can be kinda tough at times but I still push through anyways. Rule helps here a lot against the various fire based enemies here and Selena too with her water staff so all goes pretty well for the most part here.
